row: Spinal Care Chiropractic And Joint Rehabilitation

OUR APPROACH
Our goal is to get you out of pain and keep you that way. That is our bottom line.
When our doctors do an initial evaluation, we will have a good idea if your condition is something we can fix or not. If we can fix it, we will explain to you what the problem is, how it will be fixed and about how long it will take. If it is something that we cannot fix, we will explain that too, and we will work with you to get you to someone who can help whether that is an orthopedist, pain management specialist, physical therapist or other provider. Once we get you out of pain, we will work with you to help keep you that way and prevent reinjury. Our job is to fix the injury and release you. We do not want to see you back in our office repeatedly or for a long term plan.
